headline: Your website is healthy and more secure.
summary: In September we fixed how Google indexes every page, restored the brand fonts, cut image weight by 89% and closed 72 security alerts.
improvementsNote: The main changes this month, each tied to an area of ongoing care.

improvements.title: Every page now indexed on its own
improvements.body: Every page used to point Google to the homepage. All 10 now appear separately.

improvements.title: Brand fonts restored everywhere
improvements.body: Most visitors saw stand-in fonts. The GKR brand typefaces now load for everyone.

improvements.title: Contact form checked on the server
improvements.body: Every enquiry is now validated before it is sent, blocking misuse of the form.

improvements.title: Packages updated and trimmed
improvements.body: Next.js and React were updated, and 46 unused packages were removed.

nextMonth: Count contact form enquiries correctly in Google Analytics
Limit how often the contact form can be sent
Improve the mobile menu and colour contrast for accessibility
